## Summary

Describe the user-visible result and why the change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `make check` passes locally.
- [ ] Tests cover deterministic behavior, or the PR explains why they cannot.
- [ ] Input or unlock changes were tested on a physical Mac.
- [ ] Mouse and trackpad input remain available while locked.
- [ ] Touch ID, the ten-second mouse hold, and timer recovery behave as documented.
- [ ] Documentation reflects behavior, permission, setup, or privacy changes.
- [ ] `project.yml` and the generated Xcode project are in sync.
- [ ] No personal development team, credential, certificate, build output, typed content, or other sensitive data is included.

## Screenshots

Include screenshots only for visible UI changes and remove unrelated personal information.
